text: Peroni Nastro Azzurro has been owned since 2016 by Asahi Group Holdings, a Tokyo-listed brewer, with no state shareholder.

source.quote: We acquired the Peroni, Grolsch, Meantime and related businesses of SAB Miller plc in October 2016.
